selection.name: Playwright CLI (C03)
selection.role: Unranked finalist for one browser-CLI slot: attributable page snapshots and bounded interaction through the existing coding agent.

basis.shows: Documents navigation, interaction, snapshots carrying Page URL and Page Title, targeted snapshot search, depth limits, configurable timeouts and session cleanup. Supports existing coding agents without a separate research harness; requires Node.js 18+.
Current-head Ubuntu test job SUCCESS. This verifies its upstream test suite, not primary-source coverage or citation accuracy.
Current-head macOS 15 test job SUCCESS; architecture-specific arm64 execution was not verified.
CI runs npm ci and npm run test on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows.
Release published 2026-09-28, with navigation, snapshot and session fixes.
Recent maintenance activity: macOS session-path issue updated and closed on 2026-09-30.

selection.name: agent-browser (C06)
selection.role: Unranked alternative for the same browser-CLI slot: direct URL reading and browser interaction with explicit output and domain bounds.

basis.shows: Documents a native Rust CLI, direct URL reader, rendered-page interaction, URL/title retrieval, timeouts, maximum output and allowed-domain controls. Explicit Claude Code/Codex integration and Linux x64/macOS arm64 binaries.
Current release's Linux x64 build SUCCESS.
Current release's macOS arm64 build SUCCESS.
Current-head Native E2E Tests FAILURE. Cause and affected scenarios remain unverified; this materially limits confidence.
Reproducible command-latency/resource benchmark compares this project's Node and Rust daemons in a microVM; it does not compare packet candidates or measure citation correctness.
Provides Claude/Codex command-use evaluations and independently graded browser smoke scenarios; no paired research-quality result against Playwright CLI was retrieved.
Release published 2026-10-01, addressing authentication controls, browser launch freezes and bounded browser-service timeouts.
Recent maintenance activity: macOS arm64 packaging issue updated and closed on 2026-10-01.

excluded.name: OpenResearch
excluded.fact: Upstream describes a local research-agent workspace with a running service, independent parallel agent sessions and autonomous experiment loops—the additional standing research-agent stack this requirement excludes. https://github.com/alphaXiv/OpenResearch/blob/ee36ef0333ca3c533eace915f1bec322a1efde1c/README.md

layers.deciding_comparison: The selection contains unranked alternatives for one CLI slot, not a recommendation to install both. Playwright CLI has the cleaner observed cross-platform test snapshot; agent-browser documents broader reading and bounding controls. Neither establishes measured research superiority. On clean WSL2 Ubuntu x86_64, freeze primary-source URLs, expected passages and citation checks; use identical Claude Code/Codex models and command/output budgets. Measure source coverage, final-URL attribution, extraction completeness, link/form interaction success, timeout behavior, returned bytes/tokens, latency and cleanup. Include redirects, dynamic pages, authenticated fixtures and Markdown alternatives, then repeat the finalists on macOS arm64. Add a crawler or service only against reproducible failures of this baseline. Maintenance does not eliminate any candidate: all ten are unarchived, have default-branch commits within 90 days and recent issue activity. Seven have recent GitHub releases; Firecrawl MCP's latest GitHub release is from 2025, while Exa and Tavily returned no GitHub releases, despite recent commits.
evidence_gaps: The mandated ctx_fetch_and_index route rejected all eight requested page fetches: “MCP tool call requires approval, but approval policy is never.” README and source evidence was retrieved through the explicitly permitted GitHub API instead; the requested ctx_fetch/ctx_search workflow could not be completed.
Budget used: zero web searches, eight rejected page-fetch requests and 30 GitHub API calls, including three GraphQL batches. No local project records were read beyond the supplied packet.
No packet comparison ran the finalists on the target host. No verified public comparison measured their primary-source coverage or citation correctness.

Agent-browser's E2E log request was rejected by gh because the response contained terminal escape sequences; its failure cause remains unknown. Different projects' CI suites are not comparable task-success benchmarks.
WSL2 clean installation was not tested. Playwright CLI's macOS arm64 execution was not specifically verified; agent-browser documents arm64 binaries and has a successful arm64 build.

Linux/macOS suitability for the Python/npm service clients is partly inferred from their runtimes, not architecture-specific testing. Basic browser retrieval does not document a GPU requirement; RTX 4090 performance was not evaluated.

External benchmark/paper pages could not be retrieved through the required tool. Trafilatura's numerical result comes from its upstream evaluation source; Browser Use's benchmark image scores were not verified.
The complete Linux browser/system-dependency procedure for Playwright CLI was not established by its README. Agent-browser explicitly documents install --with-deps.
No candidate was excluded for requiring payment: reviewed service-backed tools document keyless access or local/self-hosted alternatives.
